channel.title: AiRE Estate Academy Guides
channel.description: Plain-English guides for real estate agents using AI.

item.title: What Does It Actually Cost to Make an AI Listing Video?
item.description: Tuition, subscriptions and usage credits, separated: what an AI listing video really costs per clip, per showcase and per month, with sourced prices.

item.title: AI Courses for Real Estate Agents Compared: Cost, Time, Credit and What You'll Make
item.description: Five paid AI courses for real estate agents side by side: price, hours, CE or designation credit, instructor access, what you make, and enrollment status. Sourced and dated.

item.title: Using AI to Write Listing Descriptions: The Fair Housing Rules Still Apply
item.description: AI can draft a listing description in seconds. The Fair Housing Act applies to every word you publish, whoever wrote it. Here is what to check before it goes live.

item.title: Texting Real Estate Leads: The Consent Rules in Plain English
item.description: What the TCPA requires before you text a lead, what changed in 2025, the hours you can text, and why STOP has to mean stop.

item.title: AI Virtual Staging: Do You Have to Disclose It?
item.description: Virtual staging and AI photo edits: what the NAR Code of Ethics, MLS rules and California's 2026 law require, and the edits that are never safe.

item.title: Premium Listing Packages: What You Pay For, and What You Can Make Yourself
item.description: What premium listing packages on the big platforms include, which parts an agent can now make with AI, and which parts still need a professional.

item.title: How to Make a Listing Video Without Hiring a Drone
item.description: Three ways to get an aerial-style listing video, what each one costs, and where AI-generated video stops being safe to use in a property ad.

item.title: ChatGPT, Claude or Claude Code: Which Does a Real Estate Agent Need?
item.description: A plain-English guide to the difference between AI chat apps and Claude Code, what each one costs, and which real estate jobs each one is for.
